introduction: Lord Braddistock still haunts his mansion and asks about his missing pet. Follow the clues into its hidden cellars, release Slippers, and return the collar.
orientation: Ask lord help at the road outside the mansion. He believes you are from pest control and wants his missing pet found.
Inspect the library's old tome and its note, then search the cellars for concealed passages. The rat infestation is dangerous.
The silver key carried by the Rat Lord releases the chained jaguar. Return its collar to Lord Braddistock. A supplied collar also satisfies his request.
Books, treasures, and the titan maul have exploration clues of their own; they are not additional quest completions.

contacts.name: the spirit of Lord Braddistock
contacts.description: Ask for help finding Slippers; the lord mistakes you for pest control.

contacts.name: the apparition of Lord Braddistock's pet jaguar
contacts.description: The chained pet needs the silver key. Its meowing is ambient behavior; give it the key to release it.

stories.title: Release Slippers
stories.summary: Give the silver key to the chained jaguar in the hidden laboratory. Slippers departs and gives you the collar that Lord Braddistock wants.

steps.hint: The Rat Lord carries this key in the deepest cavern. A supplied key also works.

steps.text: Give the silver key to the chained jaguar
steps.hint: The freed pet gives you its collar. Return that collar to its owner to finish the mansion story.

stories.title: Quiet the mansion
stories.summary: Return Slippers' collar to Lord Braddistock to receive 150,000 experience and his remains. Freeing the pet with the Rat Lord's silver key is a known route to the collar.

steps.hint: The Rat Lord in the deepest cavern carries the silver key. A supplied collar lets you proceed to the owner without this route.
Give the silver key to the chained jaguar in the hidden laboratory. Its collar is the proof the owner accepts.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a collar with an inscription, "Slippers"
steps.hint: The freed jaguar gives you the collar. A collar supplied by another player also satisfies this delivery.
Give the collar to Lord Braddistock. His promised later payment is narrative; the actual reward is experience and his remains.
